what_happened.line: The School Committee voted 4-0 by roll call to accept the year-end open purchase orders carried from FY22 into FY23.
It voted 4-0 to post three positions: a district resource nurse, an LPN and a weight room supervisor.
It voted 4-0 to accept the school handbook revisions, and 4-0 to send a revised universal school meals letter to the legislature.
The nurse position is grant-funded and phases out at the end of next year; the weight room supervisor is funded under the local grant.
A joint meeting with the select board to interview for the committee vacancy was planned for July 19; the next meeting was set for August 31.

why_it_matters: Open purchase orders are spending already committed that lands in the FY23 year, including a network and wi-fi replacement tied to a local match for E-rate funds.

Two of the three new posts are paid by grants rather than the general fund, and the nurse grant phases out at the end of next year, so the cost may later move onto the town budget, mostly taxes; the minutes do not say whether it will.
